mapper.insert: insert into sys_defect_plan_baseline (project_id, frozen_by, frozen_time) values (#{projectId}, #{frozenBy}, #{frozenTime})
insert into sys_defect_plan_baseline_item (baseline_id, defect_id, plan_start_time, plan_end_time) values (#{baselineId}, #{defectId}, #{planStartTime}, #{planEndTime})
mapper.select: select item_id, baseline_id, defect_id, plan_start_time, plan_end_time from sys_defect_plan_baseline_item where baseline_id = #{baselineId} order by defect_id

select null as item_id, null as baseline_id, defect_id, plan_start_time, plan_end_time from sys_defect where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0' and plan_start_time is not null and plan_end_time is not null order by defect_id
